name: terraform
title: Terraform
description: Search the Terraform registry for providers, modules and policies, and read and manage HCP Terraform workspaces when given a token.

params.name: tfe_token
params.description: HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise API token. Without it only the registry tools are available.

params.name: tfe_address
params.description: Terraform Enterprise base URL. Leave unset for HCP Terraform; a self-hosted address also needs an egress override.

egress.reason: provider, module and policy documentation from the public registry
HCP Terraform workspaces, runs and variables when a token is set
